verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API, webhooks, OAuth connections, and directory listings for partner embeds such as Tableau, Mixpanel, Canva, and Sketch. None of it documents a UI extension or custom-view framework that would let a designer build native-feeling views or dashboard widgets. The API and the partner embeds are building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
